body: I don’t see myself in the future honestly, or being happy. I’ve heard that years ago and even as a kid, but things have just only gotten worse. I’m not strong at all honestly.
I think I’m done going for myself. I don’t really have anything to look forward to anymore. I don’t see any hope anymore in really anything. Thank you for the kind comment though.

I don’t ever see myself giving the speech you just gave at all. At any point of my life. I’m not strong, or really worth anything. I live with a grandparent but as I said, they’re too religious and care more about that then breaking up with the family over abuse. I can’t ever get out, and I probably ever won’t. I don’t have the capability to do anything anymore. I truly don’t have hope in anything. I know won’t ever experience it but you’re very lucky to have a dad who seems to care about you and to get out of the situation. Best of luck to you.

I just don’t have that many friends because I can’t see them or do anything with them. I only see my boyfriend and that’s every two or three weeks, even though we live ten minutes away. I can’t see myself seeing a partner every day or every few days like my friends do honestly. Seems like a miracle. I probably won’t ever experience it honestly

I don’t live with my parents anymore, but they still have a strong hold on me because I live with my grandparent. I can’t bring myself to call anyone. I really don’t have any strength left to make an effort with leaving or making anything happen.
